reference.note: Rebuilt rather than pulled. No published AI Workbench image exists, and the published pair that does exist carries a workbench whose nginx forwards /ai-host/ without stripping the prefix. A reference does not have to be a registry artefact: trusted source plus a reproducible build is one.

approvalNote: CANDIDATE: this records the reference as built. Nobody has compared the migrated workbench against it, so it is not an approved baseline — that requires a person looking at both sets of screenshots.
